rules.statement: Never seed or grant control-plane management scopes (server, server-settings, server-secrets and tenant-provisioning families) to a workload tenant; seed them only into the root tenant, and seed tenant-plane resource servers into every tenant.
rules.why: Control-plane scopes must not leak into workload tenants. Only the root tenant, which is the control plane, administers servers and tenants.
rules.check: Look for seeding or provisioning code that adds control-plane scope families to every tenant without checking whether the tenant is the root tenant, or for new control-plane scopes added to a tenant-plane provider.

rules.statement: Read the root tenant identifier from configuration options with a named default constant, not from a hard-coded string literal.
rules.why: The root tenant id defaults to "root", but each deployment can override it, so a hard-coded value breaks deployments that configure a different id.
rules.check: Look for comparisons against or uses of a literal like "root" for the root tenant id, instead of reading the configured options value.
